ten_stack_red_team.socratic: The uncertainty is whether repeated RV persistence adds information beyond literal persistence; current evidence cannot answer it.
ten_stack_red_team.dialectic: JH01 has the cleanest perishable discriminator and existing authority; Order Flow is more action-direct but data-blocked; Funding is mechanistically strong but needs a new contract and has no deadline.
ten_stack_red_team.popper: JH01 fails if valid 365-origin C_JH01 does not beat B1 by >=5% MSE with adjusted-MSPE HAC p<=0.05; integrity failure blocks classification.
ten_stack_red_team.causal: JH01 is predictive forecast value, not causality or economic edge. Order Flow/Funding would initially be predictive association/action-utility evidence, not causal proof.
ten_stack_red_team.systems: JH01 yields a reusable forecast-state requirement; it does not justify Router/State Snapshot. Order Flow would yield a more direct action-utility piece only after coverage repair.
ten_stack_red_team.cybernetics: JH01 improves feedback toward decisions by testing whether a known state estimate improves forecasts; it is not infrastructure-only work.
ten_stack_red_team.bayesian: Repeated positive persistence raises belief in persistence, not automatically in incremental fitted-model value; the selected test is therefore belief-changing but bounded.
ten_stack_red_team.mdl: JH01 is one compact extra-parameter test against literal persistence; Router/State Snapshot would add representation before redundancy is resolved.
ten_stack_red_team.doe: The cheapest clean discriminator is the already-frozen one-comparison V1 design with existing panel, schedule, benchmark, and recorder.
ten_stack_red_team.adversarial: Missed origins, pre-origin persistence, held-out access, drift, interim metrics, and forecast-to-edge laundering are explicit kill risks and remain prohibited.
medium_findings: JH01 is upstream of E[U(a)|X] and cannot be described as action-utility evidence until a separate cost-aware action question is earned.
low_findings: The prospective campaign is operationally demanding, but its scope is already bounded by the exact one-campaign schedule.

decision.why_this_wins: It tests the strongest repeated state relation against the simplest persistence benchmark, with a fixed outcome-blind protocol and a perishable 2026-09-15 first origin. Exact campaign authority and recorder already exist, so no speculative plumbing is needed now.
decision.primary_scientific_question: Does frozen fitted JH01 RV24 persistence improve outcome-unseen 24-hour RV forecasts materially beyond literal naive persistence, with HAR-style reporting secondary?
decision.null_falsification_condition: No lower C_JH01 MSE, relative MSE reduction below 5%, or adjusted-MSPE HAC p>0.05; any source/timing/persistence/coverage integrity failure blocks classification and stops the campaign.
decision.mechanism: Volatility clustering may make current RV informative about near-future RV; test whether fitted persistence adds information beyond using current RV literally.
decision.expected_information_gain: high and decision-changing for whether RV persistence is redundant state description or a useful forecast primitive
decision.relation_to_E_U_action_given_X: Indirect but foundational: tests one earned observable state component. It does not estimate TREND/REVERSAL/FLAT utility ordering or authorize routing.
decision.why_not_runner_up_1: Order Flow is more action-direct, but all 60 windows remain coverage-blocked and require high-risk source/provenance repair. It has no time pressure or scientific result; JH01 has a clean frozen discriminator and unconsumed authority.
decision.why_not_runner_up_2: Funding incremental value is strong and correctly remains open after the old directional null, but requires a new preregistration/input qualification and is not time-sensitive; selecting it would forfeit the fixed JH01 opportunity without a stronger information argument.
decision.minimum_required_new_infrastructure: None for selection. Later work reuses the exact qualified wrapper/recorder; no Router, State Snapshot, Qnty, or scientific evaluator implementation is authorized here.
decision.data_required: Existing frozen 20-symbol Binance USD-M perpetual 1h source contract and outcome-blind per-origin inputs; no market data is accessed in this phase.
decision.prospective_or_historical: PROSPECTIVE_OUTCOME_BLIND_COLLECTION; final evaluation only after 365 origins
contamination_controls: Fixed 2026-09-15 first origin and exactly 365 daily origins; no skip/substitute/moved date/second campaign.
Persist forecast before outcome availability; strict source cutoff <= origin; no open/partial future bars.
Fixed C_JH01/B1/B0/B3 models and primary MSE/5%/Clark-West-HAC gates.
No interim metrics, rankings, p-values, or held-out outcome outputs.
Stop on missing/duplicate/reordered origin, digest mismatch, or authority violation.
decision.stop_condition: Stop permanently on any frozen kill condition or missed origin; no backfill, rescue, date/model/benchmark/metric change, or blocked-result reinterpretation.

authority_reconciliation.scope: Exactly one JH01 V1 campaign, 365 daily origins 2026-09-15..2027-09-14, fixed 20-symbol panel/source contract, qualified immutable-release recorder; operational collection only.

review.review_conclusion: Selection maximizes bounded decision-changing information under the deadline, reuses infrastructure, does not repeat consumed work, is falsifiable, and grants no downstream authority. The medium finding is a scope limitation, not a blocker.
